name: PM-KISAN (Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi)
description: An income support scheme that gives small and marginal farmer families direct cash assistance, paid in three instalments a year, to help meet farming and household expenses.
eligibility: Small and marginal farmer families who own cultivable land, subject to standard exclusion criteria such as income-tax payers, current or former government employees above a certain level, and other high-income professionals.

name: Ayushman Bharat – Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (PM-JAY)
description: A health insurance scheme that covers hospitalisation costs for secondary and tertiary medical care, allowing cashless treatment at empanelled hospitals across the country.
eligibility: Families identified as deprived or vulnerable under the Socio-Economic Caste Census (SECC) 2011 database. There is no cap on family size, age, or gender of members covered.
documents: SECC eligibility confirmation or PM-JAY card

name: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana (PMAY – Urban and Gramin)
description: A housing scheme that provides financial assistance for building or buying a pucca (permanent) house, aimed at families who currently live without one.
eligibility: Families without a pucca house. The urban component covers EWS, LIG, and MIG income categories with defined income limits; the rural (Gramin) component targets houseless and kutcha-house families identified through SECC data.
documents: Land or property documents, where applicable

name: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana
description: A small-savings scheme for a girl child that offers a relatively high, government-fixed interest rate, meant to build a fund for her future education and marriage expenses.
eligibility: Parents or legal guardians of a girl child below 10 years of age can open the account in her name. A family may generally open up to two such accounts, with exceptions for twins or triplets.
documents: Birth certificate of the girl child
Identity proof of parent or guardian

name: Central Sector Scheme of Scholarship for College and University Students
description: A merit-based scholarship that gives students from low-income families financial support to cover day-to-day expenses while pursuing undergraduate studies.
eligibility: Students who passed Class 12 in the top percentile of their board (typically 80th percentile and above), are pursuing a regular undergraduate course, and whose total annual family income is up to ₹4.5 lakh.

name: Post Matric Scholarship Scheme for SC Students
description: Financial assistance for Scheduled Caste students studying at the post-matriculation stage, covering tuition and maintenance costs so students can continue their education.
eligibility: Students belonging to the Scheduled Caste category, studying in Class 11 and above, whose total family income does not exceed ₹2.5 lakh per year.

name: Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana
description: Provides a free LPG gas connection to women from low-income households, to replace unsafe cooking fuels like firewood and cow-dung cakes with clean cooking gas.
eligibility: Adult women from BPL households and other specified low-income categories who do not already have an LPG connection registered in their household.

name: Atal Pension Yojana
description: A voluntary, government-backed pension scheme that guarantees a fixed monthly pension after age 60, aimed mainly at workers in the unorganised sector who lack formal retirement savings.
eligibility: Indian citizens aged 18 to 40 years with a savings bank account or post office savings account; generally not available to income-tax payers under current guidelines.

name: Pradhan Mantri Mudra Yojana
description: Offers collateral-free loans of up to ₹10 lakh to small and micro, non-farm businesses, to help individuals start or expand manufacturing, trading, or service ventures.
eligibility: Indian citizens with a viable business plan for a non-farm income-generating activity; loans are categorised as Shishu, Kishor, and Tarun depending on the amount needed.
documents: Business plan or proof of existing business

name: Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana
description: A national financial inclusion scheme that gives citizens access to a basic, no-minimum-balance bank account, a RuPay debit card, and accident insurance cover.
eligibility: Any Indian citizen who does not already have a bank account, with a particular focus on individuals from low-income or previously unbanked households.
documents: Aadhaar card or other valid ID proof
